spans.s:
धिष् 1. धिष् (thought by some to be
an abbreviated form of a Vedic Desid.
दिधिष् derived fr. rt. 1. धा; connected with rt. 1.
धी), cl. 3. P. दिधेष्टि, &c., to sound, emit a
sound; to praise, celebrate by hymns (?).

2. धिष्, f. (only occurring in inst. धिषा and
probably connected with rt. 1. धी), fixing the mind,
attention (?), intelligence (?), devotion; (Sāy.) = धि-
षणा, knowledge, understanding; action; praise,
hymn.

धिषण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. धिष् substi-
tuted for rt. धृष्), ‘the intelligent one,’ N. of
Bṛhas-pati, preceptor of the gods and regent of the
planet Jupiter, the planet Jupiter itself [cf. धिष-
णाधिप and धी-मत्]; any Guru or spiritual pre-
ceptor; epithet of a Nārāyaṇa; N. of an astronomer;
of an evil spirit or demon; (आ), f. a sort of Soma-
vessel, a cup, goblet, bowl; a Soma press; (accord-
ing to some commentators) the Soma juice itself and
its effects; (metaphorically धिषणे, f. du. the two
cups or bowls, i. e. the two worlds or heaven and
earth; and धिषणास्, f. pl. the three worlds or
heaven, earth, and the intermediate atmosphere); a
female divinity presiding over prosperity and gain,
(sometimes reckoned among the wives of the gods);
= वाच्, speech, praise, hymn; = 2. धी, intelligence,
intellect, understanding, knowledge; N. of the wife
of Havir-dhāna, daughter of Agni; of the wife of
Kṛśāśva and mother of Veda-śira, Devala, Vayuna,
and Manu; (अम्), n. a dwelling-place, abode, seat,
site, resting-place [cf. धिष्ण्य]; understanding,
intellect.
—धिषणाधिप, अस्, m. ‘lord of the
planet Jupiter,’ epithet of Bṛhas-pati.
धिषण्य, an adj. formed by Yāska (Nir.

धिष्ट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, placed on a fire-altar (?);
(wrong reading for धिष्ण्य, q. v.)

धिष्ठ्य, अम्, n. site, seat, place, (wrong reading
for धिष्ण्य, q. v.); (अस्), m. fire; the planet
Venus (?).
—धिष्ठ्य-प, अस्, m. world-protector.

धिष्णीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. intended for or
belonging to the Dhiṣṇyas, i. e. certain receptacles
or places for fire.

धिष्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. only perceptible by
the mind; (Sāy. = धार्ष्ट्य-युक्त), endowed with
fortitude; intelligent, thoughtful, devout, pious;
(Sāy.) to be praised or meditated upon; worthy of a
high station; placed upon the heaps of earth used
for side-altars; see below. In Ṛg-veda

,
Sāy. explains धिष्ण्या by प्राणास् = the divinities
presiding over the vital airs; (अस्), m. a place for
the sacrificial fire, a sort of inferior or side-altar,
(generally a heap of earth covered with sand on which
the fire is placed, and of which eight are enumerated,
cf. आग्नीध्रीय, मार्जालीय, &c.); an epithet of
Uśanas, the planet Venus; power, strength; (अम्),
n. a site, seat, place, abode, spot, region, house; a
star, asterism, (looking like the fire on the side-altars);
a meteor.
